description: The closed set of model ids the REVIEW capability may resolve to on a model-id provider. Policy, fabric-coordinator's (policies/AUTHORITY.md): the reviewer's model is chosen here, deliberately, never by a profile layer on its own; a project's architecture role proposes, the coordinator lands. tools/fabric/lint.py refuses a committed profile whose merged review model is outside this set, and runtime/openrouter/launch refuses the MERGED result at launch (the local override layer is where an unreviewed model would otherwise sneak in). Coding classes — code-low, code-medium, code-high, code-plan — are not gated by this file. Decision 2026-09-13 (the owner, holding architect-cto; landed by fabric-coordinator): z-ai/glm-5.3 is admitted and is the default review model on the broker path; Opus 5 stays admitted for a profile that wants it. Add a router or preset here only after a live test has shown the harness forwards that reference verbatim. Decision 2026-09-19 (the owner, in the coordinator's session; architect-cto informed): deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro-0813 is admitted and is the default review model on the broker path. The reason is the tier, not the family: the owner runs adversarial local review and wants the reviewer on the strongest admissible broker model — the same model the session, code-high and code-plan now ride, so the independence the review class has is the blind brief and a fresh context, not a different family (that holds only against code-low and code-medium, which stay GLM). Live-checked 2026-09-14 through deepseek2claude-shim on Ionstream (docs/live-checks/2026-09-14-deepseek.md). v4-flash is tested and refused there and is not admitted. Decision 2026-09-25 (the owner, in the coordinator's session): anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 is admitted and is the review model on plain claude, where every class now rides Opus 5.5 — so on that path the review's independence is the blind brief and a fresh context, not a different model or effort. The [1m] marker is dropped because Opus 5.5's context is natively 1M (docs/live-checks/2026-09-23-opus-5-5.md), which closes the review-grade question that note left open; the first review on it ran on #40 of agent-fabric. Decision 2026-09-29 (the owner): code-low and code-medium moved to Sonnet 5.5; the review stays on Opus 5.5 with code-high and code-plan, so the 2026-09-25 sentence about every class holds for the upper classes only.
